title: Jazz auf Tegemis
author: Joerg Rosenbauer
description:
You're the captain of a commercial freighter, and you just finished a delivery to the dreary planet Tegemis IV. Looking for a little recreation, you decide to visit a local jazz bar.
But how could you settle for an evening of light entertainment after this alien beauty winks at you? You just have to find out what she wants.

1st Place Textfire Grand Prix 2004
